locator: V.4.1, οὐ γὰρ δὴ σώματα λέγομεν δύο ... ἡ δὲ ἀρχὴ ἀγέννητος
interpretation: Source reading recorded in prose only. Source argument recorded in prose. Ungenerated is not read as existence at a first temporal instant, and no theorem about modern physical simples, fields or a material cosmos is claimed.
